versions.changelog: Three new failure patterns from real gateway incidents: (1) clean-exit supervisor restart treated as final by Restart=on-failure service units — use Restart=always plus StartLimitBurst; (2) impostor gateway — a stale superseded unit serving the port with passing health checks while dispatching nothing; (3) native module bindings missing after plugin install/update, including the ignore-scripts=true trap that makes npm rebuild a silent no-op. Also documents the 2026.6.x npm/projects managed plugin layout. SKILL.md pitfalls and update-failure-patterns.md (patterns 24-26) updated.

v1.1.0

- Add Agent Context section to SKILL.md: external agents (CLI, survive restarts) vs in-gateway agents (must schedule a cron wake before gateway restart; prefer native gateway/cron/message tools over shell)
- Fix scripts/refresh-openclaw-docs.sh file/directory conflict by appending .md to extensionless URLs (per llms.txt), yielding clean Markdown in the cache
- Drop cli-reference.md; replace with CLI Discovery in SKILL.md so the catalog cannot drift from `openclaw --help`
- Trim config-map.md to hot-reload vs restart reference only; generic config shapes belong in docs
- Add Notable Config Choices and Rescue / Incident Workspace sections to local-install.md for per-install values that used to be implied by generic examples
- Add explicit "do not auto-refresh docs mid-incident" guidance
- Version marker added to SKILL.md frontmatter for staleness checks
Add bundled docs guidance and live docs cache refresh helper
Add generic install profile and update runbook references

Gate reads of session/workspace file contents on explicit user approval (listing stays unrestricted). Session bodies never leave the conversation. Addresses ClawHub scan feedback on agent session PII exposure.

Add Scope & Safety section (local-only; never open secrets.json/.env or transmit externally; explicit confirmation gates for destructive ops) and GitHub source link. Addresses ClawHub security scan feedback.

Update doc discovery for recent npm builds: point to online docs (docs.openclaw.ai), GitHub source tree, or local clone — recent npm builds ship only a small reference/ subset. Add 'openclaw --version' as the first diagnostic step. Generalize <npm-prefix> paths.

Initial release of openclaw-admin.

- Diagnose, configure, and repair OpenClaw installations.
- Direct filesystem access for inspecting and editing config, secrets, and logs.
- Step-by-step diagnostic workflow and safe configuration editing practices.
- Extensive documentation indexing and search guidance.
- Common troubleshooting tips for Discord, authentication, secrets management, the gateway, and agents.
- Emphasizes backup, validation, and safe editing to prevent config loss.
